parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.leads (
    external_id,
    event_id,
    lead_name,
    lead_email,
    lead_phone,
    lead_source,
    status
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6,
    'new'
)
ON CONFLICT (lead_email)
DO UPDATE SET
    lead_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.lead_name, public.leads.lead_name),
    lead_phone = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.lead_phone, public.leads.lead_phone),
    lead_source = EXCLUDED.lead_source,
    event_id = EXCLUDED.event_id,
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING
    internal_id,
    external_id,
    event_id,
    lead_name,
    lead_email,
    lead_phone,
    lead_source,
    status,
    created_at,
    updated_at;

options.queryReplacement: ={{[  $('Normalize Deduplication Input').item.json.external_id,  $('Normalize Deduplication Input').item.json.event_id,  $('Normalize Deduplication Input').item.json.lead_name,  $('Normalize Deduplication Input').item.json.lead_email,  $('Normalize Deduplication Input').item.json.lead_phone,  $('Normalize Deduplication Input').item.json.lead_source]}}

UPDATE public.raw_events
SET payload =
        payload
        || jsonb_build_object(
            'lead_id', $2::integer,
            'deduplication', $3::jsonb
        ),
    processing_status = 'lead_resolved',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE internal_id = $1
RETURNING
    internal_id,
    external_id,
    processing_status,
    payload;

INSERT INTO public.workflow_logs (
    event_id,
    lead_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    wf_message,
    workflow_name
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    'lead deduplication completed',
    'success',
    $3,
    '02 - Lead Deduplication Resolver'
)
RETURNING internal_id;

const data = $('Build Deduplication Result').first().json;

return [
  {
    json: {
      run_id: data.run_id,
      event_id: data.event_id,
      external_id: data.external_id,
      event_source: data.event_source,

      lead_id: data.lead_id,
      lead_name: data.lead_row.lead_name,
      lead_email: data.lead_row.lead_email,
      lead_phone: data.lead_row.lead_phone,
      lead_source: data.lead_row.lead_source,

      company_name: data.company_name,
      company_domain: data.company_domain,
      website_url: data.website_url,
      job_title: data.job_title,
      message: data.message,
      budget: data.budget,
      timeline: data.timeline,
      country: data.country,

      normalized_lead: data.normalized_lead,
      deduplication: data.deduplication
    }
  }
];

UPDATE public.raw_events
SET last_execution_id = $2,
    last_workflow_name = $3,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE internal_id = $1
RETURNING internal_id;

normalized_lead.message: We want to automate lead routing and CRM follow-up creation. Right now inbound leads from paid campaigns are reviewed manually, enriched by the sales operations team, and assigned to account executives in spreadsheets before being updated in CRM. We need a workflow that deduplicates leads, scores them, assigns priority, creates follow-up tasks, and alerts the right team.
